そして、上へ上へと目指し、這い登ってゆく。<br>希望の奥底から生まれ、絶望の待:
And so it climbed, ever upward—born from the depths of hope,
bound for the land where despair awaited.
地上を目指す冷たい眼差しは、そして、今、見つめている。<br>闇深き大穴の底を目:
The cold gaze that had once been fixed on the surface now
turned—watching the youths who sought the bottom of the dark Abyss.
